updates.title: First public update feed
updates.summary: First public update feed for published copies of Easy Sourdough Baker, with weekly checks for coaching guidance, videos, and recipes. Updates never overwrite a baker's own recipes, starter name, notes, or reminders.
changes: First public update feed for published copies.
Weekly checks for coaching guidance, videos, and recipes.
Updates refresh coaching guidance only and never overwrite a baker's own recipes, starter name, notes, or reminders.

updates.title: Owner asks before each weekly share and each update
updates.summary: Published copies now ask their baker before sending this week's Hive Mind notes and before applying a public update. Only bot setup information moves through Hive Mind. No personal information, passwords, account details or private data is ever sent or received.
changes: Ask before each weekly Hive Mind share, and send only after a yes.
Ask before applying a public update, and apply coaching guidance only after a yes.
An update that asks for passwords, logins, codes, keys, account access or personal info is skipped, and the baker is told.

updates.title: Published copies install the hive client from this repo
updates.summary: The hive client now lives in this repo as client/hive, so a published copy can download it onto the baker's computer, keep its own database, and refresh the client when an update is applied.
changes: Add client/hive and a short client README for published copies to install.
hive update --yes may refresh the client file.
Creator-only commands fail harmlessly without GitHub access.

updates.title: Printable recipe cards
updates.summary: Published copies can make a printable recipe card and a large-text tablet view from a baker's own saved recipe, then walk them through it in chat. Personal recipes are never overwritten by Hive Mind updates.
changes: Add a reusable recipe-card template and a helper to fill it from JSON and print a PDF.
The same card has a large-text tablet view (one section at a time, tappable checkboxes) and a compact letter layout for print.
Keep each baker's recipe as their own JSON, re-render after adjustments, and record a short why line.
hive update --yes also fetches the card templates. Personal recipe files are never overwritten.
